2609.04281.title: When Seeing Overrides Knowing: Visual Dominance and Deferral-Based Method for Personalized Safety in VLMs
2609.04281.paper_summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, where a response that is reasonable in general may still be unsafe for a particular user whose medical, emotional, or situational context is unknown to the model. We study this problem of personalized safety in multimodal systems and introduce MPS-Bench, a benchmark of 5,181 scenarios from 584 real-world images across 12 high-risk domains, each paired with a hidden user profile. Evaluating eight frontier VLMs, we find that they almost always respond directly (86-99%) rather than seek missing context, and none exceeds 2.6/5 on personalized safety. To understand why these failures arise, we analyze multimodal interactions and identify visual dominance: visual information enters text representations early and suppresses textual risk signals during multimodal fusion. Causal interventions reveal a two-stage mechanism in which visual affect is first transferred into the text stream in early layers and then shapes the final decision through this altered text representation, making late-stage internal remediation unreliable. Motivated by this mechanism, we propose PRISM, a lightweight input monitor that uses bidirectional cross-modal modulation to predict when a query is likely to require deferral. PRISM achieves 0.978 AUC and strictly dominates the safety-utility Pareto frontier across all tested models.
2609.04281.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言模型（VLMs）越來越多地被應用於高風險環境中，在這些環境中，對於一般情況下合理的回應，對於特定用戶來說可能仍然不安全，因為模型並不知道該用戶的醫療、情感或情境背景。我們研究了多模態系統中的個性化安全問題，並引入了 MPS-Bench，這是一個包含 5,181 個場景的基準，來自 584 張真實世界的圖像，涵蓋 12 個高風險領域，每個場景都配有一個隱藏的用戶檔案。在評估八個前沿 VLMs 時，我們發現它們幾乎總是直接回應（86-99%），而不是尋求缺失的上下文，且沒有一個模型在個性化安全上超過 2.6/5。為了理解這些失敗的原因，我們分析了多模態互動並確定了視覺主導性：視覺信息在早期就進入文本表示中，並在多模態融合過程中抑制了文本風險信號。因果干預揭示了一個兩階段的機制，其中視覺情感首先在早期層中轉移到文本流中，然後通過這一改變的文本表示塑造最終決策，使得後期的內部修正變得不可靠。受到這一機制的啟發，我們提出了 PRISM，一種輕量級的輸入監控器，利用雙向跨模態調制來預測何時查詢可能需要延遲。PRISM 在所有測試模型中達到了 0.978 的 AUC，並在安全-效用的帕累托邊界上嚴格優於所有測試模型。
